Field: History, philosophy, education, psychology / 11/PHIL-04 Estetica e filosofia dei linguaggi

Research, teaching and third mission activities in GSD 11/PHIL-04, SSD PHIL-04/A – Aesthetics, relating to the aesthetics of taste and the philosophy of food.
